<function name="SetSpawnPoint" parent="team" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Sets valid spawnpoint classes for use by a team.

<note>GM.TeamBased must be set to true for this to work</note>
	</description>
	<file line="80-L87">lua/includes/modules/team.lua</file>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="index" type="number">Index of the team</arg>
		<arg name="classes" type="any">A spawnpoint classname or table of spawnpoint classnames</arg>
	</args>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Allows TEAM_BLUE to spawn at terrorist spawn points</description>
	<code>team.SetSpawnPoint( TEAM_BLUE, {"info_player_terrorist"} )</code>

</example>
